params.name: referringAccountId
params.description: When included, filters the results to only referrals that were referred by users with this `AccountId`

params.name: referringUserId
params.description: When included, filters the results to only referrals that were referred by users with this `UserId`

params.name: dateReferralPaid
params.description: When included, filters the results by an exact timestamp or a comma-separated range for when the referral was paid.

params.name: dateReferralEnded
params.description: When included, filters the results by an exact timestamp or a comma-separated range for when the referral ended.

params.name: referredModerationStatus
params.description: Filters the result to only include referred users with that status: `PENDING`, `APPROVED` or `DENIED`.

params.name: referrerModerationStatus
params.description: Filters the result to only include referrers with that status: `PENDING`, `APPROVED` or `DENIED`.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of results returned.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offsets the first result to return in the list for pagination.
